symbols.name: useFormBlock
doc: I keep one form's state here: its values, the fields the person has been in, the server's errors, the review step and the same-name question. Adding and changing each get their own.

symbols.name: EmployeeAdminPanel
symbols.sig: export function EmployeeAdminPanel({ open, photoDeps = browserPhotoDeps }: { open: EmployeeAdminOpen; photoDeps?: PhotoDeps })

behaviours: the header: Employee manager, then the person's NAME, then 'Authorised executive', one row with one gap
the HOD's header says 'HOD of C&IT'; until the name arrives there is no empty element; the name is escaped
the HOD has five tabs: Add, Change, Delete, Authorised people, Recent changes
a delegate has THREE: Add, Change, Recent changes (no Delete, no Authorised people)
the form has its four sections: Identity, Posting, Service dates, Contact; and the live card
the fields: ticket, SAIL P.No., name, DESIGNATION CODE, DEPARTMENT CODE, dates, mobile, address (and NO 'position in the grade' field: the server places him last)
until the Identity is right the designation code and the department code are INACTIVE, offer nothing, and the section says what to do first
once the Identity is right (an executive ticket) they are ACTIVE and offer only the executive codes, as 'code · title' in groups: no non-executive code is there
a ticket that is not an executive's (and does not start with 0) offers only the non-executive codes
the department codes are a list of the VALID codes of that cohort, each with its name: an executive is offered 100 and 107 (executive), never the codes reserved to non-executives
...a non-executive is offered 100 (shared), 9003 and 107 (his own), with his own names
a chosen designation code shows its title and kind under it; a typed department code shows the department's name
under the ticket the form says what he is: non-executive, executive promoted, executive direct recruit (Management Trainee)
changing a person: the ticket field is locked and says so
while the sections above are not complete the contact fields are inactive, and the card says what to complete first

an EXECUTIVE: the NIC mail field (@sail.in) and the web-mail field (@saildsp.co.in) are active and there is NO general E-mail field at all (owner, 2 Nov 2026: it was only a greyed 'Not used for an executive')
...the web-mail domain is the right one (@saildsp.co.in), and the wrong 'sail-dsp.in' appears nowhere
...the executive's mobile is the CUG number: labelled so, with the rule (94347 and then 9, 2 or 3)
a NON-EXECUTIVE: ONE e-mail field, any address, optional; NO NIC mail and NO web-mail field; a plain optional mobile
in a change the mobile and the e-mails start EMPTY and show what is there MASKED: 'Now 943479xxxx. Type a new one to replace it.' (never a whole number or address)
the HOD sees the two dates, with the live line under them: age, the farewell day, service, the jubilee day
a delegate sees NO date field: a locked card says the dates are the HOD's alone (and no date appears anywhere in what is drawn)
a warning (joined after 32) is drawn in the dates card; the date pickers stop at today and at 1930
the button is OFF (greyed) with the reason in words; ON without a hint
an error is shown under its field, in red, announced; the field is marked invalid
everything typed is escaped
the live card: capitals, initials, designation, department and the origin
an empty card shows placeholders; initials: one letter for one word, a question mark for none
the review of a change lists what changes: what, now, will become
the review of a new employee is a summary (an empty field reads a dash)
a same-name clash asks 'Is this a different person?' with Yes and No, naming the other person
a busy review cannot be confirmed twice
the list shows name, ticket, designation, department, and a Change button; Delete only for the HOD
an empty search says so
the history is a table: When, What, Details, Done by; a change shows field by field old to new; a hidden date stays 'hidden'
...who did it: name, ticket, post and role; the time in India
history text is escaped
resolveDepartment: by CODE, among the departments that fit the ticket's cohort (107 is two departments: the executives' and the non-executives')
gradeLabel: 'code · title'
rawOf: the department code becomes its id, the designation a number, the position is NEVER sent, the contact fields go as typed, the doctor flag true / false (was a doctor, box cleared) / null

changesOf: field by field, only what differs (the name tidied, the designation by title, a new grade says 'last in the new grade'), and a typed mobile or mail shown IN FULL as typed (the person checks it), marked as replacing, while the stored value stays masked (step 69b)
changesOf: nothing differs, nothing listed; the dates are left out when the person may not see them
changesOf: a non-executive's typed e-mail is listed as 'E-mail', not as a NIC mail
the panel first shows the header, the tabs and the Add form with the posting fields INACTIVE; the button is off ('Loading…' until the codes arrive)
a request to change opens on the search; to delete (the HOD) on the search for the delete; to delegate on the people tab; a delegate asking to delete is put on Add
the name or ticket the sentence carried is already in the Add form; the search text in the search box
stage 1 (nothing filled): the Identity is the CURRENT step; Posting, the dates and Contact are LOCKED
stage 2 (Identity complete): the Identity is DONE, Posting is CURRENT and its fields are active; the dates and Contact are still locked and inactive
stage 3 (Posting complete): Posting is DONE, the dates are CURRENT and active, Contact is still locked
stage 4 (the dates complete): the dates are DONE and Contact is CURRENT with every field active; with the whole record right Contact is DONE too
a locked card says what to complete first: Posting waits for the Identity, the dates for Posting, Contact for the dates (and for Posting only, when there are no dates)
a locked card does not repeat 'inactive' under every field (the card says it once)
the progress rail counts the complete sections and says when everything is ready
for an authorised executive the dates card is a neutral 'HOD only' lock (not a green tick) and does not hold up Contact
the designation list and the department list draw the SAME arrow at the SAME place (one drawn chevron, the same style on both)
...both lose their native arrow (appearance-none) and have the same height and padding; the datalist's own black triangle is made invisible (kept only as a click area)
no native arrow style survives on either box (no second arrow)
an empty date shows its 'dd/mm/yyyy' LIGHT (an inline grey) and a filled one in the normal colour; the calendar icon is soft
a date box that is not open yet is inactive
each input has its icon and, once right, a green tick inside the box; a wrong one a red alert
the live ID card shows the kind of employee in a chip (MT, promoted, non-executive) and the ticket in monospace
the doctor switch is a real toggle (a checkbox the keyboard reaches, drawn as a switch), only for an executive

the action bar is DOCKED at the bottom (solid, square, flush with the bottom of the scrolling area: sticky -bottom-2) and carries the button and the reason; the frame clips its glows with overflow-clip (overflow-hidden would stop the bar from sticking)
the history marks each action with a coloured dot, once (the verb is not repeated in a pill)
the name that came with the answer that opened the panel is in the header on the FIRST paint (the server-side render, where no request can have been answered yet)
...in the right place: after the title, before the role label
with no name in the answer and no session the header has no name yet (it is asked for), and nothing is thrown without a session provider
with no name in the answer the LOGIN COOKIE's session name is used at once (no request)
the name from the answer (the people directory's, the one the history records) wins over the session's
a blank name in the answer falls back to the session's; a blank session name is no name
a name is trimmed and escaped (a tag in it is text)
the name is NEVER used to decide anything: the panel takes the role from the answer, the session name only feeds the header
the start-up no longer waits for two requests together: the name request (only when no name is known) and the lookups are separate, so the name is shown as soon as it arrives
the stale card is an alert that says somebody else changed the record, and that nothing of the person's was saved
...it says WHO and WHEN (in India time)
...it lists what they changed, each as 'it was' and 'it is now'
...and offers the two ways on, each with its own mark: keep my edits on top (the main button) and show their version
...with the reassurance that only what the person changed goes on top, so he cannot put back what they changed
without a recorded change (it was made by something that records nothing) the card still says it was changed, without a name
when nothing visible differs (a contact number, shown masked) the card says a detail not shown here was changed
both buttons are disabled while a request is on its way
everything the card draws is escaped (a tag in a name or a changed value is text)
a message can be AMBER (something to look at): its own tone, announced politely, with its mark
the panel sends the VERSION the person saw with every change and every delete, and handles the 'stale' answer of each
the save button waits (and says why) while the card is shown, so a second click cannot repeat the refused save
'keep my edits' is the three-way merge (rebaseForm of the form as opened, what is typed now, and their record) and 'show their version' replaces the form with theirs
choosing another person to change, or cancelling, clears the card
no <form> tag in the code (the search modal holds a text area; forms must not nest)
ADDING and CHANGING have SEPARATE states (two form blocks): what was loaded or typed in one never shows in the other; switching tabs does not reset either
a saved CHANGE refills only the Change form; a saved ADD empties only the Add form
the sections open FROM TOP TO BOTTOM: the panel works out what is open with unlockedSections (employeeFormModel.ts) and the button also waits for the last section
the 'still mounted' flag is switched ON again at every mount (StrictMode)
every request has a time limit, and a failing one becomes a sentence, never a hang
the panel never decides who may do what: no ticket, no role is sent, only the fields
dates are drawn with Luxon only (no built-in Date)
the search modal draws the manager from analytics.employeeAdmin, after the PAX editor and before the hospital card
the delete card does not print the ticket number: the title is only the name, and the label says 'Type his ticket number to confirm' (no number in it)
the box is the shared TypedConfirm (pasting switched off) with the same mark as before, and the button still waits for the right number
the executive's CUG mobile says it is OPTIONAL and can be added later, in the field's hint and in the 'at a glance' card (nothing says required)
the tab and the list button are called MODIFY (not Change)
the name is typed in CAPITALS at once, whatever the keys do, and the caret stays where it was (a box that uppercases what it receives)
the review of an ADD shows what was typed in full (no mask), and the panel no longer imports the masks
